title: Hang It Up
cues: Service call. Gym AC. Saturday
Dim gym lights, a lone HVAC unit glows orange, a digital clock displays 9:00 AM
intro_or_break
Y'all need a fifth?
Shadowy figures gather, hands reaching out, a suggestion of a sixth person emerging from darkness
intro_or_break
Pulled up in the work van with my name stitched on the shirt
A battered work van, chrome glinting, silhouette against a brick wall, a stitched patch visible
intro_or_break
Ridgeview gym on a Saturday, I came to fix a unit, came to work
Hardwood floor, blurred motion of sneakers, a few dark shapes rising for a jump shot
build
Five young boys on the hardwood, talkin' slick and shootin' threes
Young figures in motion, a spray of red from a basketball, a focused, intense moment
build
One of 'em says, "Ay, AC man, you need a fifth? Bring your knees"
A hand extends, palm up, a shadow mimicking a knee bend, a dark, predatory gesture
build
Forty-eight, bad shoulder, steel-toe boots, a little gut
Steel-toe boots planted firmly, a blurred outline of a torso, a tool belt hangs loosely
build
Took my tool belt off, set my gauges down, and said, "Check it up"
A hand gestures upwards, a wrench suspended mid-air, a sense of command and control
build
First possession, kid's in my face, he's quick, I'll give him that
A quick burst of movement, a figure dodging, a momentary flash of a dark shirt
build
But I been readin' pressure gauges twenty years, I read him flat
A pressure gauge spins wildly, a hand slams down on a control, a decisive, forceful action
drive
Jab step, he bites, I go left and never leave the floor
A dancer's leap, a silhouette frozen mid-air, defying gravity with fluid grace
drive
Kiss it off the glass, and the old man's up, now keep the score
Glass shattering, a ripple effect, a stoic figure standing, observing the scene intently
drive
"Hang it up, old man," that's what the young boys said
Dark figures surrounding a high point, a sweeping gesture towards the ceiling, red light pulses
drive
Point up to the rafters, thirty-one in red
Red light streaks across the rafters, a dense network of beams, a sense of vastness
drive
They hung it up in ninety-five, it's hangin' over your head
A towering shadow hangs above, a subtle threat, a feeling of being watched
drive
Been above you all day long, and you ain't looked up yet
A dizzying spiral of color, shifting between dark blues and reds, conveying heat and cold
drive
Second quarter, now they double me, they double me with youth
Figures swarm, a chaotic clash of movement and shadow, geometric shapes layered on top
drive
They got legs, I got angles, I got geometry and proof
A complex series of angles and lines, a feeling of calculated strategy and dominance
build
I don't run, I relocate, I'm a thermostat, I set the room
A thermostat adjusts, a stream of cool air visualized as a vortex, controlling the environment
build
You be runnin' hot, I'm blowin' cold, you'll be gassed by noon
A figure collapses, exhaustion, a swirling vortex of dark smoke, a slow demise
build
Elbows like a contractor, pump fake like a lie
An elbow extends in a deceptive motion, a hand mimics a lie, a subtle trickery
build
Moved a teenager like a dresser up the stairs, then I let it fly
A teenager is slowly lifted, a silhouette moving upwards, a sense of forced relocation
drive
Kid says, "Yo, who the hell is you?" I say, "Lamont. I fix the air"
A hand points, a questioning glance, a shadowed figure deep in thought
drive
Hit another off the dribble, he says, "Bro, you played somewhere?"
A basketball spins through the air, a blurred trajectory, a casual inquiry

drive
I just point up at the rafters with the ball still in my hand
A ball is tossed towards the rafters, a single point of focus amidst a chaotic scene
drive
Every head in that gym tilts up, and the room goes quiet fast
Everyone turns their heads upwards, a collective silence, a sudden and absolute stillness
drive
Thirty-one, BYERS, ninety-five, still hangin' from my past
The number '31' glows intensely, a ghostly imprint in the rafters, a haunting memory
drive
Then I let it go from the logo while they're starin' at the sky
A shot rings out, a streak of light, a moment of perfect execution
drive
Swish before they look back down. Never even saw it fly
Figures turn away, lost in thought, a lingering image of the ball's trajectory
drive
Then I ride the lift up to the unit right beside the beam
A lift ascends, a mechanical eye watching, a sense of methodical precision
drive
Wipe the dust off my number while I'm fixin' the machine

drive

drive

The figures stand in a circle, a sense of respect, a quiet dominance

drive

drive
Hung it up in ninety-five, and I'm still a step ahead
The number '31' hangs suspended, a symbol of triumph and legacy
drive
Ay, AC man. Same time next Saturday?
A shadowy hand extends, a question posed, a lingering invitation
drive
Bring your knees
